answer: In a recycling exchange, agents bid to clear ferrous scrap from a vine-covered yard. Each bid must carry a device certificate and a fresh attestation of its measured kernel, then lock a bond until signed pickup records pass a random audit. The exchange allows one active bid per certified device, so ten aliases on one laptop gain only one slot; ten slots require ten devices, deposits and crews. Rented devices or a compromised certificate issuer can still defeat this gate, and honest workers may replace hardware, so rotate challenges, audit issuers and provide a transfer appeal.
